description:
Turn inbound email into HTTP notifications: send a message to the UnitySVC SMTP gateway and it is delivered to your own HTTP endpoint as a compact `{title, body, type, format}` JSON payload — the email's subject becomes `title` and its body becomes `body`.

Anything that can send email — cron jobs, monitoring alerts, application mailers, legacy tools — becomes a webhook to a receiver you control, without that sender ever holding a URL or credentials. This is the summary view of a message; if you need the full email (all headers, attachments, both bodies, DKIM/SPF), use the `smtp-to-email` service instead.

Multi-channel: the free `byok` channel forwards every message to one receiver you store once as customer secrets (`HTTP_RELAY_BASE_URL`, optional `HTTP_RELAY_API_KEY`); the metered `plus` channel routes different mailboxes to different receivers, each enrollment binding its own `base_url` and reached at a unique `/e/<code>` address. See “How to use this service” for both channels.
name: smtp-to-msg

payout_price.description: No platform commission — customer uses own HTTP receiver
